[[File:Nature Infliction icon.png|right]]
[[Nature Infliction]] is an [[Arts Infliction]] in [[Arknights: Endfield]].

== Overview ==
[[Nature Infliction]] is a debuff applied by Operators lasting for {{Color|20|1d}} seconds. If Nature Infliction is applied to a unit who already has Nature Infliction, then the debuff's duration is reset and the Nature Infliction gains a stack (up to a maximum of 4 stacks).

=== Friendly ===

Some [[Operators]] are capable of applying [[Nature Infliction]].
* If an Operator applies Nature Infliction to an enemy with Nature Infliction, then an [[Arts Burst|Nature Burst]] is triggered dealing {{Color|160% ATK|1d}} as {{Color|Nature DMG|5}}.
* If an Operator applies Nature Infliction to an enemy with a [[Arts Infliction|Non-Nature Arts Infliction]], then [[Corrosion]] is triggered.

=== Enemies ===

There are no [[Enemies]] currently capable of applying [[Nature Infliction]].

==Changelog==
{{Changelog|
* <b>Beta Test II</b> {{Needs Verification}}
** {{G|Nature Infliction}} can now stack up to four times.
*** [[Arts Burst|Nature Burst]] changed.
**** <b>New:</b> When an Operator applies Nature Infliction to an enemy with Arts Infliction, add one more stack of Nature Infliction (up to 4 times) and trigger an Nature Burst.
**** <b>Old:</b> When an Operator applies Nature Infliction to an enemy with Nature Infliction, {{G|Debuff Consumption|consume}} the Nature Inflictions and trigger an Nature Burst.
*** [[Corrosion]] changed.
**** <b>New:</b> When an Operator applies Nature Infliction to an enemy with a non-Nature Arts Infliction, {{G|Debuff Consumption|consume}} existing stacks of Nature Infliction to trigger [[Corrosion]] with the latter determining the strength or {{G|Status Level}} of the reaction.
**** <b>Old:</b> When an Operator applies a Nature Infliction to an enemy with a non-Nature Arts Infliction, {{G|Debuff Consumption|consume}} both Arts Inflictions and trigger Corrosion.
* <b>Beta Test I</b> {{Needs Verification}}
** {{G|Nature Infliction}} added.
*** When an Operator applies Nature Infliction to an enemy with Nature Infliction, {{G|Debuff Consumption|consume}} the Nature Inflictions and trigger an [[Arts Burst|Nature Burst]].
*** When an Operator applies Nature Infliction to an enemy with a non-Nature Arts Infliction, {{G|Debuff Consumption|consume}} both Arts Inflictions and trigger [[Corrosion]].
}}
